caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, ornamental design composed of three adjoining panels, rendered in shades of black and gray pencil on a beige background. The central panel is the largest and has a curved, arched top, containing a vase-like object from which stylized flames or foliage emanate upward and outward, filling most of the panel. Flanking the central panel, the two side panels are rectangular and lower in height, featuring identical depictions of a coiled, dragon-like creature with a textured, segmented body and a pronounced head facing inward toward the center. Both dragons are situated among swirling, decorative elements that echo the style of the central flames or foliage. The entire composition appears to be a detailed architectural or decorative motif, and there is a simple, faintly drawn scale or guide line directly below the main design, indicating proportions. The coloration is monochromatic, relying on shading and hatching to create depth and texture.
title: Coal Grate for Fireplace
